patch_description:
This version replaces the single-path greedy initializer with a compact multi-state beam construction. Instead of committing to one GPU choice for each model, it keeps several promising partial placements with different packing shapes, ranked by the complete sorted KVPR profile. This preserves alternatives that are slightly worse early but enable better memory packing later.

After construction, a bottleneck-focused improvement phase applies strict lexicographic KVPR improvements. In addition to relocations and one-for-one swaps, it supports both asymmetric exchange directions: replacing one bottleneck model with two models from another GPU and replacing two bottleneck models with one model from another GPU. These exchanges address memory-constrained cases where ordinary moves cannot improve the maximum KVPR.
